CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT d.*, d.rowid AS insertionOrder, e.recordId FROM text_drafts d
       LEFT JOIN text_record_edits e ON e.draftId = d.id
       LEFT JOIN text_records r ON r.id = e.recordId
       WHERE r.deletedAt IS NULL

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT t.id,t.name,t.ownerDraftId,s.revision AS stampRevision
    FROM tags t LEFT JOIN tag_stamps s ON s.tagId=t.id
